responsibility: This file implements the legacy caller-save optimization in the RTL reload pipeline. It analyzes hard registers that are live across calls, determines save/restore modes and instruction patterns accepted by the target, allocates stack save slots, tracks which hard registers are currently spilled around calls, and inserts save and restore insns into the reload insn chain while maintaining liveness information and basic-block boundaries. It is specifically responsible for synthesizing call-clobbered hard-register preservation when register allocation chooses values that must survive calls.
